title: Main Hall (Tyr's Hand)
wikitext:
[[File:Main Hall.jpg|thumb|Main Hall.]]

The '''Main Hall''' of [[Tyr's Hand Abbey]], located in [[Tyr's Hand]] in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]], is the part of the abbey through which all access to the tower, [[Hall of Arms (Tyr's Hand)|Hall of Arms]], and [[Library Wing (Tyr's Hand)|Library Wing]] is done. It was heavily patrolled by the [[Scarlet Crusade]].
